name: Cá khô nướng
summary: Cá khô nướng is grilled dried fish. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study lists it with dried fish simmered in a glaze, and calls dried seafood a favorite: many fish and squid, cured, then cooked. It says the result is fragrant. No stall price was printed.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried seafood on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: Grill the dried fish. The 16 September 2025 study also allows the same dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it, as a separate plate.
With rice at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets. The study names no shop.
seoTitle: Cá khô nướng — grilled dried fish, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Grilled dried fish in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp. The 16 September 2025 study calls dried seafood fragrant. A stall price is Check on arrival.
